title: How to Hijack the Port Gellhorn Cargo Ship in GTA VI?
tldrAnswer: Infiltrate the Port Gellhorn naval dock at 02:00 game time via submersible or rebreather. Bypass the starboard bilge valve (Terminal B-4), disable the automated coastal beacon, and eliminate 4 private security contractors on the bridge before accessing the master helm override.

steps.title: Approach Port Gellhorn via Submersible
steps.instruction: Acquire the Kraken AV-2 submersible from the Vice Beaches marina. Approach the southern docking pylon of Port Gellhorn submerged below 15 meters to avoid sweeping coastal surface radar.
steps.tip: Do not surface until you are directly inside the sea chest inlet beneath Crane 3.

steps.title: Sabotage Bilge Valve Terminal B-4
steps.instruction: Climb the maintenance ladder to Deck C. Use the Electrical Bypass PDA to override Terminal B-4. This vents excess steam into the lower corridor, forcing guards to abandon their patrol posts.
steps.tip: Requires Electrical Bypass Tool Level 2 (bought from Port Gellhorn electronics dealer).

steps.title: Neutralize Bridge Command Personnel
steps.instruction: Ascend the external emergency stairwell to the Captain's Bridge. There are 4 armed contractors equipped with body armor. Execute synchronized silent takedowns using a suppressed carbine.
steps.tip: Firing an unsuppressed weapon triggers an immediate 4-star county response with Coast Guard patrol cutters.

steps.title: Engage Master Helm Override & Escape
steps.instruction: Retrieve the encrypted nav-disk from Captain Lucia's desk safe. Insert into the main navigation console and steer the freighter 3 miles offshore into international waters until the search perimeter expires.

title: Where Do the Vice Beaches & Starfish Island Mansion Keycards Spawn?
tldrAnswer: Mansion VIP Keycards spawn in three fixed micro-locations across Vice Beaches: behind the mezzanine office safe at the Jack of Hearts lounge, inside the glove compartment of the parked Grotti Cheetah Classic at Villa 9 on Starfish Island, and on the poolside cabana lounger of the abandoned cartel estate.

steps.title: Location 1: Jack of Hearts VIP Mezzanine
steps.instruction: Enter through the service alley backdoor behind the club. Slip past the security guard and search the hidden wall lockbox behind the velvet curtain in the second-floor executive booth.
steps.tip: Avoid drawing weapons inside the venue to prevent alerting the bouncers.

steps.title: Location 2: Starfish Island Villa 9 Driveway
steps.instruction: Locate Villa 9 on Starfish Island. In the open motor court, check the white Grotti Cheetah Classic. Lockpick the passenger glove compartment to retrieve the keycard.
steps.tip: A guard dog patrols the motor court; toss prime meat bait or use a silent dart.

steps.title: Location 3: Ocean Drive Abandoned Cartel Estate
steps.instruction: Scale the terracotta wall on the southern fence of the estate. The keycard rests on the teak sun lounger next to the drained infinity pool.

author: Staff Cartographer

title: What Is the Absolute Fastest Car in GTA VI as of Patch 1.02?
tldrAnswer: The Bravado Banshee Custom holds the top-speed benchmark at 164.5 mph (264.7 km/h) stock, scaling to 186.2 mph with Stage 4 Twin-Turbo and EMS upgrades. The Grotti Cheetah Classic trails closely at 181.4 mph but possesses superior cornering stability on the Vice Beaches causeways.

steps.title: Acquire the Bravado Banshee or Grotti Cheetah Classic
steps.instruction: Order the Bravado Banshee on Southern San Andreas Super Autos or find the Grotti Cheetah Classic parked along the Ocean Drive strip outside Starfish Island between 21:00 and 02:00.

steps.title: Install Competition Upgrades at Hao's Workshop
steps.instruction: Equip Stage 4 ECU Engine Mapping, Twin-Scroll Race Turbo, Short-Ratio Gearbox, and Low-Grip Competition Radials.
steps.tip: Do NOT equip heavy ballistic chassis armor as it adds 280 kg and cuts top speed by 4.8 mph.

steps.title: Benchmark on the Vice Beaches Causeway
steps.instruction: The uninterrupted 4-mile straight stretch across the Vice Beaches Ocean Causeway provides optimal downforce conditions to max out top gear speed.

title: How to Set Up the Grassrivers Airboat Contraband Loop?
tldrAnswer: Acquire the Grassrivers Bait & Tackle marina depot, recruit a secondary runner for swamp runs, and sync midnight airboat drops with the Port Gellhorn freight schedules to launder $160K dirty cash per run at a 92% clean conversion efficiency.

steps.title: Purchase the Grassrivers Marina Depot
steps.instruction: Open Dynasty 8 Commercial Real Estate on your in-game smartphone. Buy the 'Grassrivers Bait & Tackle Depot' ($950,000 baseline price).

steps.title: Equip the Nagasaki Swamp Airboat
steps.instruction: Purchase the Nagasaki Airboat with dual fan cowlings from DockTease. This allows traversing shallow grass flats without beaching or stalling in mud.
steps.tip: Watch for alligators near the submerged mangrove chokepoint at marker G-3.

steps.title: Automate the Port Gellhorn Freight Run
steps.instruction: Every in-game day (48 real minutes), transport the Pelican crates along the Grassrivers canal into the Port Gellhorn loading docks to deposit clean cash with zero police heat.

title: How to Disable the Kelly County Radar Perimeter in GTA VI?
tldrAnswer: To disable the Kelly County Air Defense radar without triggering immediate surface-to-air missile batteries, reach the communications relay tower on the Kelly County northern ridge. Hack the substation breaker using Lucia's decryptor PDA between 23:00 and 03:00 for a 4-minute blind window.

steps.title: Scout the Kelly County Ridge Relay Tower
steps.instruction: Drive a dirt bike or off-road vehicle along the dirt ridge overlooking Kelly County Air Reserve station. Stop at the fenced transformer compound.
steps.tip: Snipe the single patrol deputy with a suppressed weapon before touching the circuit box.

steps.title: Solve the Hex Decryption Sequence
steps.instruction: Connect Lucia's Military Decryptor PDA to the main circuit breaker. Align the 3 frequency waves within 30 seconds.

steps.title: Enter Airspace Unchallenged (4-Minute Timer)
steps.instruction: A green countdown HUD timer will appear showing 04:00. You can fly any jet, helicopter, or sky-crane over Kelly County without SAM lock-on or automated AA flak.

title: Where to Find the Heavy Sniper Mark II Thermal Scope in Leonida Keys?
tldrAnswer: The Heavy Sniper Mk II Thermal Sight attachment is located inside the sunken smuggler submarine wreckage 400 meters south of Big Pine Key in the Leonida Keys. Dive with scuba gear to coordinate 24.681° N, 81.354° W and pry open the waterproof Pelican case in the torpedo bay.

steps.title: Acquire Scuba Diving Equipment
steps.instruction: Pick up the Scuba Gear from the dive shop in Marathon or board a Nagasaki Dinghy which auto-equips a rebreather tank upon exit.

steps.title: Locate the Sunken U-Boat Smuggler Hull
steps.instruction: Dive down 22 meters south of the reef drop-off near Big Pine Key. The rusted submarine hull is split into two halves.
steps.tip: Beware of hammerhead sharks patrolling the trench; carry an underwater speargun.

steps.title: Pry Open the Torpedo Bay Armory Locker
steps.instruction: Swim through the starboard hull breach into the forward torpedo room. Use a crowbar on the yellow Pelican case to unlock the Thermal Scope optic.
